author: TeIq
content: APPROVE-WITH-FOLLOW-UPS verdict from architect audit. 38 labels persisted from 4 distinct labelers (was 5 at session start). DNS storm 117→28/sec and dropping. Dormancy spread 2→144 in 75s. Queue worker draining at batch_size=8/5s. Follow-ups filed: (a) frontend display polish for 'user-friendly format', (b) persist dormant_until across restarts to eliminate startup DNS wave, (c) worker batch tuning once dormancy is widely spread.
